acts: FDA prescribing information published on DailyMed

en.title: amoxicillin: 2.2 and 8.4 give different instructions for one patient
en.summary: 2.2 reads “Aged 3 Months (12 weeks) and Older”. 8.4 reads “12 weeks or younger (3 months or younger)”. Example: An infant aged exactly 12 weeks falls under Table 1 of 2.2 and also under the 30 mg/kg/day upper limit of 8.4 and Highlights. The same text is in 181 labels from 35 labelers in the DailyMed release of 29 October 2026.
en.impact: Potential effect on a prescribing decision: low; careful reading of the whole label usually resolves it. Arxo does not say which instruction is correct and gives no dose.
